    "Initial learning curve for some advanced features compared to previous platform.",
    "Occasional complexity in managing specific shipping profiles for large furniture items.",
    "Design customization options sometimes required more technical effort."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This CEO likely found BigCommerce to be a strategic upgrade, primarily due to the significant cost savings from avoiding transaction fees for their high-value furniture sales. The platform proved robust enough to manage their e-commerce operations for over two years, indicating it met their core business needs and offered better value. While some aspects might have had a steeper learning curve or required more effort than their previous platform, the overall benefits outweighed these minor frustrations, leading to a positive and long-term commitment."
